text:
anya: Heads-up — after yesterday's kernel-affinity tweak (auto-pinning FP8 for matmuls, INT8 for FFNs) we see a reproducible eval delta and some structured JSON outputs breaking on a subset of prompts.

kevin: Can you paste a minimal repro or eval diff?

anya: Quick paste: eval job id 2026-03-17-mixq-42, metric drop ~3.1% on schema-ful generation tests. Example output truncated field: "items": [{"id": 123, "meta": { ... <<cut>> }". Also extra tokens like "�" occasionally inserted.

maria: That's worrying. Any stderr/telemetry from runtime?

anya: From the runtime profiler: 

```
[2026-03-17T23:12:11Z] kernel_select: selected fp8_gemm_v2 for layer 7
[2026-03-17T23:12:11Z] kernel_select: selected int8_ffn_v1 for layer 8
[2026-03-17T23:12:11Z] kv_cache: hit but length_mismatch detected (expected 1024, saw 1016)
[2026-03-17T23:12:11Z] write_output: serialized 880 bytes, consumer read 864 bytes
```
kevin: length_mismatch in KV cache + serialization size mismatch points to either memory layout/dtype mismatch or a kernel that writes fewer KV entries. Could be quantization packing change.

raj: Do we have kernel change diff from last deploy? Was affinity/pinning the only change?

anya: Deploy bot shows the release: 

```
release: mix-quant-scheduler-2026-03-17
changes:
 - enable kernel_auto_pin=true
 - add fp8_gemm_v2 kernel (opt-in)
 - new int8 packer with 4-bit fallback
```

maria: We should test two quick hypotheses: 1) kernel_auto_pin causes different kernels to be used for some shapes -> writes incompatible KV layout; 2) fp8_gemm_v2 has a bug in tail handling causing fewer tokens in KV.

kevin: Agreed. Repro steps I ran locally:
```
# run eval subset
./eval_runner --model mix-quant-v2 --profile --seed 42 --prompts-file small-schema.jsonl
# capture KV lengths
./kv_inspector --session 2026-03-17-mixq-42 --dump
```
I see layer 7 kv_len 256 -> layer 8 kv_len 252. Should be identical shape after matmul/ffn pair.

anya: I also reran with kernel_auto_pin=false and fp8_gemm_v1 forced -> metrics back to baseline on same eval subset. No truncation seen.

raj: So revert is a low-risk mitigation. Can we also add a runtime assert to validate KV lengths and either fallback or log detailed dump?

kevin: I'll put a hotfix patch to: 1) disable auto_pin by default; 2) add KV length assert in dev builds; 3) add a sampling hook that uploads full serialized outputs for failing cases to S3 for offline debugging.

maria: Also create an e2e test that exercises odd tail sequence lengths and schema generation to catch this in CI. Add a small golden JSON compare.

deploy-bot: Rolling back mix-quant-scheduler-2026-03-17 -> mix-quant-scheduler-2026-03-10 (requested by kevin).

anya: After rollback eval job re-run shows metric delta resolved. I'll keep a failing trace and attach to the bug.

kevin: For follow-ups: pair with runtime/ops to profile memory writes in fp8_gemm_v2 and audit packer logic. Tagging @maria for test PR and @raj for kernel review.

maria: Working on test PR now, will include the small reproducer and CI guard.

raj: I'll run kernel microbench + memcheck under sanitizer, and run a tox of mixed shapes.

anya: Thanks all. Filing bug: RH-3841 with attached trace and eval diff. Will update when we have kernel root cause. :white_check_mark:
